images.caption: Figure 1:Overview of HuRo for real-world manipulation.We transform large collections of human activity videos into robotized episodes using visual robot overlay and motion retargeting. The resulting episodes contain language instructions, robot states, and actions that we use for VLA policy pretraining. Policies pretrained on larger HuRo subsets achieve higher real-world manipulation performance after downstream finetuning.
Figure 2:Overview of HuRo dataset construction pipeline.Human videos are annotated, retargeted into robot actions, and visually converted into robotized observations to form HuRo episodes.

(b) Effect of visual robotization.
